basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software engineer living in the Pacific Northwest, with a passion for electronic music and culinary experiments. When I'm not coding or diving into a new tech project, you can find me cooking up chaffles or exploring the local music scene. I'm a night owl, often online during late evenings and weekends. Currently single, I enjoy the freedom to travel and attend music festivals. I have a soft spot for classic movies and am a huge fan of Scarlett Johansson's work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working in tech for over a decade. My expertise spans software development and systems architecture, but I've also developed a keen interest in digital music production through self-teaching and community involvement.
